mission.objective: Consume the completed Agent Decision Inspector contracts and connect ADL Agent Runner to the pinned BAGO Embedded Runtime, preserving explicit proposals, user approval, BAGO receipts, ADL traces, fail-closed behavior, and blocked filesystem.delete.
mission.title: Governed BER Agent Runner follow-up

deliverables: Explicit blocked effects and runtime limits
done_when: Prior W01-W12 handoffs remain preserved
Only the persisted agent profile and registered BER effects can be used
Human approval is bound to one prepared request and is required for material writes and process execution
No delete, arbitrary shell, or execution-success claims without a matched BAGO receipt
Standalone package and local smoke evidence are recorded
work_items.title: Freeze BER Agent Runner scope and review prior mission contracts

done_when: Client-supplied agent config is never execution authority
Unknown effects, mismatched approval, replay, denied authorization, unavailable provider/runtime, failed execution, and missing receipt all fail closed
Existing BAGO BER API remains the effect executor and source of authority/receipts
filesystem.delete remains unavailable
Tests validate no job/success is recorded before verified BER receipt
work_items.title: Implement backend Agent Runner over BER with fail-closed authorization

done_when: UI displays proposed action and exact effect arguments before approval
Approval/rejection is a user action bound to the current proposal id
Unknown/error/pending states are not presented as success
Run success requires an exact receipt identity from the backend
Keyboard-accessible loading, empty, error, approval, rejection and success states pass tests
work_items.title: Connect Agent Runner UI to the governed proposal and receipt flow

done_when: Unauthorized and rejected action cases prove no material effect
Wrong/stale/replayed approval and mismatched/missing receipt cases are covered
Provider/runtime errors cannot yield success
filesystem.delete and arbitrary shell attempts are denied
No P0/P1 finding remains open; all NOT_RUN scopes are explicit
work_items.title: Independently verify the live runner flow and adversarial boundaries

deliverables: Backend WebSocket regression test aligned with the governed start/error contract
done_when: The test sends a valid bounded start frame or an invalid frame and cannot wait indefinitely
Assertions match current stable error codes and fail-closed behavior
No real provider inference or BER effect is invoked
work_items.title: Replace obsolete backend test for the governed WebSocket start contract

deliverables: Final runner status and residual limits
done_when: W13-W16 and W15R handoffs validate
Independent verification has P0=0 and P1=0
Backend, UI, full relevant tests and standalone container smoke pass on the same candidate
Runner is enabled only with its BER-backed path and remains fail-closed for unsupported effects
No publish/deploy occurred
work_items.title: Terminal BER Agent Runner mission gate
